honestDisclosures: First broadcast attempts (audit-log entries 2-3, hashes 0x3327baea59…, 0x80a5506d…) were accepted by the RPC but never mined: 28 workers share one deployer key and same-nonce replacement dropped them. Retried with --async; both mined. The dropped attempts stay in the log as the true record, disclosed by the note:mempool-drop-disclosure entry.

cast send WITHOUT --async appeared to return hashes that never reached the mempool in this environment; with --async the tx was visible via eth_getTransactionByHash within 1s and mined within seconds. Root cause not fully determined; the mined receipts are the evidence.

The Atlantic RPC rejects eth_getLogs topic filters (PARAM_VERIFY_ERROR: invalid topic length, verified live) and HTTP-400s unfiltered ranges over a few hundred blocks. The report therefore scans unfiltered logs in 200-block chunks with client-side topic filtering, and caps native-transfer block scans (default 4000 most-recent blocks) — both disclosed in every report header.
The scanned wallet is the shared LIGHTKEEPER deployer key: the report reflects all 28 workers' activity, not only this agent's. Totals are real chain data for that wallet over the scanned window.
